description: CBS Census2022 resident composition, country of birth/origin and aliyah cohorts. Each percentage retains its own denominator; merged reporting areas count once. The snapshot excludes subsequent aliyah and cannot identify individual votes.

level.description: List locality or published statistical-area profiles when no locality_code is given; default localities. With locality_code the response includes its profile and paginated areas.

limit.description: Maximum matching records per page, 1–50; default 10.

locality_code.description: Filter by official CBS locality code, for example 4000 for Haifa. Omit to search across localities.

offset.description: Number of matching records to skip for pagination, 0–10000; default 0.

query.description: Optional search text, up to 100 characters; empty means no text filter.

stat_area_code.description: Published Census2022 statistical-area code within locality_code. Requires locality_code; returns the published combined area when applicable.

name: get_demographics
